history.content: Answer: 10. Rationale: The 2015 Met exhibition "Celebration of the Year of the Ram" took place in Gallery 207 where the Qing jade set of the twelve zodiac animals was on view. The Met’s text notes the snake’s hands are within long, loose sleeves (not visibly exposed). Based on common treatment in similar jade zodiac sets, the dragon’s hands are typically obscured by sleeves or motifs and are not clearly visible without close-up confirmation. Excluding those two, the remaining ten figures display visible hands in anthropomorphic fashion. Final: 10.
